name: NBCU Editorial Standards
description: Editorial standards skill for breaking news. Flags informal language in headlines and surfaces missing compliance flags on BREAKING stories.

rules.name: Informal language in headline
rules.description: Flags use of newsroom-informal terms in story headlines. Encourages a more formal alternative for broadcast standards.
rules.detail_template: Informal term '{term}' in headline. Consider formal alternative.

rules.name: Missing compliance flags on BREAKING
rules.description: Inform-severity warning when a story enters BREAKING phase with no compliance flags attached. Standards desk should verify before air.
rules.detail_template: BREAKING story has no compliance flags. Verify with Standards desk.
